newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable despite fund inflows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable despite fund inflows.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against the U.S. dollar as month-end U.S. dollar demand almost balanced inflows of foreign funds, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.475 against Monday's T$27.473 close. Turnover was a modest US$198 million.

Dealers noted persistent foreign fund inflows ahead of Morgan Stanley's planned inclusion of Taiwan in its global stock indices from September 2. "But after the Taiwan dollar hit resistance at T$27.46, month-end U.S. dollar demand emerged to almost balance the trade," said one dealer. A T$27.45-27.50 range was seen for Wednesday. -James Peng (5080815)
